# Visual Studio Code on the empty file %TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt, with
# "files.autoSave": "afterDelay" and a short "files.autoSaveDelay", so the file
# on disk shows what the editor holds without any extra key presses.
layout:en
wait:1500
type:ghbdtn
tap:alt
file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt:привет
expect-layout:ru
tap:alt
file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt:ghbdtn
expect-layout:en
tap:ctrl
file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt:GHBDTN
tap:ctrl
file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt:ghbdtn
show
# A word that was not typed just now.
key:end
tap:alt
show-file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt
expect-layout:ru
tap:alt
show-file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt
expect-layout:en
# A selection.
key:shift+home
tap:ctrl
show-file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt
key:end
# A new word after a space, with a trailing space.
type:\sntcn\s
tap:alt
show-file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt
tap:alt
show-file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt
# Nothing selected and nothing typed just now: the line must not be duplicated.
key:left
key:right
tap:ctrl
show-file:%TEMP%\keyflip-check.txt
